name: Salzburgring
notes: Salzburgring (clockwise, as OSM tags the oneway raceway): start/finish westbound on the south straight past the pits (Boxengasse), the Nockstein loop at the west end, the long Gegengerade east, the Fahrerlagerkurve hairpin at the east end and the Schikane back onto the start straight. Raceway loop over the members of OSM relation 19552391 (today's layout). The 1987 lap was 4.225 km; whether every chicane of today's track was there in 1987 is unverified. Traced 4187 m. speed_scale copied from the 1991 Group A tracks, uncalibrated for 1987.
